row.proto: void Get(void *comp, struct{int val;char ok;} *out, uint32_t team_key, char category)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Finds the team record (vector comp+0x298..0x2a0, stride 0x30, key +0x28), walks its bank entries (stride 0x1b0) and looks up byte category in the bank budget map (bank+0x60, same map written by Career_Bank_ApplyTransactionToBalance: key byte, int sum at +4). Returns optional<int>: the team's budget for that category (read-only; used by AutoContracts ranking and facility ticks).

verify.notes: V9491 Finds team record (+0x298..+0x2a0, 0x30 stride, key +0x28), uses bank entry map at +0x60 (swiss table, 0x14-byte slots: byte key, int at +4), returns optional int for the category byte.
